sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The game's controls are responsive and intuitive, allowing players to navigate through the castle with ease. The game also features a variety of items and power-ups that players can collect to aid them in their journey. These items can be used to overcome obstacles, solve puzzles, or even manipulate the environment. Overall, Castel's core gameplay mechanics are engaging, challenging, and rewarding.

One of the standout features of Castel is its focus on exploration. Players are encouraged to explore every nook and cranny of the castle, discovering hidden secrets and items along the way. The game's exploration mechanics are also well-integrated, with a clear sense of progression and discovery.

The game's puzzles are also cleverly designed, requiring players to think creatively and use their problem-solving skills. The puzzles are not too difficult or too easy, making them accessible to players of all skill levels. The game also features a variety of puzzle types, including environmental puzzles, logic puzzles, and platforming puzzles. Overall, Castel's core gameplay mechanics are engaging, challenging, and rewarding.
